reason: A VS Code extension that embeds the DeepSeek Harness web GUI and manages its local server lifecycle, primarily providing an integrated navigation panel.

summaries.zh: 在 VS Code 的侧栏或编辑器标签页中嵌入 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面，并自动连接或管理本地服务。
summaries.en: Embeds the DeepSeek Harness web interface in a VS Code sidebar or editor tab and automatically attaches to or manages its local server.

capabilities: Embeds the DeepSeek Harness web interface in a VS Code sidebar or editor tab
Attaches to an existing local DSH server or starts one automatically
Spawns and stops local processes, including optional npx-based CLI download and shell commands
Restarts self-started servers when the workspace changes or a process fails
